definitions.explanation: The number eleven. Formed by combining {十|じゅう} (ten) and {一|いち} (one).

⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{十一|じゅういち}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.english: Soccer is a sport played with eleven people.

notes:
{十一|じゅういち} is formed from {十|じゅう} (ten) + {一|いち} (one), following the regular pattern for numbers 11-19.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {十一時|じゅういちじ}: eleven o'clock
- {十一月|じゅういちがつ}: November
- {十一歳|じゅういちさい}: eleven years old
- {十一人|じゅういちにん}: eleven people
- {十一日|じゅういちにち}: the 11th (of the month)

PATTERN:
Japanese numbers 11-19 are completely regular: {十|じゅう} + single digit. This makes the Japanese number system one of the easiest to learn.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In soccer (サッカー), a team has eleven players, so {十一|じゅういち}{人|にん}で{試合|しあい}をする is a common expression.
